outcomeNote: A single anonymous mishna ruling; no dispute, no named parties, no dialectic.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ פָּחוֹת מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ נִידָּר, אֲבָל לֹא נֶעֱרָךְ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» A child «less than one month old is» the object of «a vow» if others vowed to donate his assessment, «but is not valuated» if one vowed to donate his fixed value, as the Torah did not establish a value for anyone less than a month old.

moves.summary: The mishna rules that a child under a month old is the object of an assessment vow but not of a valuation vow.
